scope: Completed fixed 24-sensor by 12-interval A/B research transport and finite/nonnegative-output checks. No comparison with qualified references, full annual convergence or release acceptance.
concurrency: Both runs were observed under concurrent controlled-reference and native bridge work, with at most eight heavy one-worker processes. Timings are not isolated performance promises.
representation: Every assembled per-sensor RGB component and lux value, declaration, process record and primary receipt is embedded. Full per-patch coefficient matrices and finite raw ray outputs remain local; their hashes are retained.

primary_stream.rule: Hammersley cosine hemisphere: radius=sqrt((i+0.5)/N), azimuth=2*pi*base2_radical_inverse(i), z=sqrt(1-radius^2); sensor-major, i=0..N-1; no rotation/scramble; sensor origin+1e-4 upward; identical uninterrupted full/direct streams

declaration.scope: Experimental full-grid candidates; no comparison with unqualified controlled references
declaration.primary_rule: Hammersley cosine hemisphere: radius=sqrt((i+0.5)/N), azimuth=2*pi*base2_radical_inverse(i), z=sqrt(1-radius^2); sensor-major, i=0..N-1; no rotation/scramble; sensor origin+1e-4 upward; identical uninterrupted full/direct streams
declaration.conversion: pi/100 times full coefficient diffuse product plus pi/100 times full-minus-direct solar product plus finite direct
declaration.nonnegative_policy: Reject negative coefficient and assembled reflected terms; retain every failed value, never clamp
declaration.reference_policy: Only qualified controlled references may establish max(5lx,5%) matched agreement; MF2 sky is identical, annual MF4 convergence remains separate
declaration.sensitivities: Controlled reference qualification and its fixed sensitivities remain separate; none counted by this candidate experiment
